nom: Dior Dreamskin Care & Perfect - For a Skin-Perfecting, Filter Effect

segments.mature: A 64-year-old reviewer and a 45-year-old reviewer report using the product, with mixed results: one saw no visible effect and speculated it works better on younger skin, the other has used it for about ten years and finds it keeps her skin soft and silky.

concerns.aging: One reviewer in her 30s and a 64-year-old reviewer mention age in relation to results; the 64-year-old noticed no effect and wondered if the product suits younger skin better, while a 45-year-old long-term user reports consistently soft, silky skin.
concerns.spots: Two reviewers specifically mention cystic acne, both reporting improvement: one says the serum cleared her skin completely, another says it helped her cystic acne while also calming and hydrating.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers dealing with texture unevenness and skin discoloration alongside acne report the product cleared these issues; no dissent on this point among those who mention it.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the product calms her skin, though this is a single mention with no elaboration.
concerns.dehydration: One reviewer says the product hydrates; no other reviewer discusses dryness or dehydration directly.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with sensitive eyes reports stinging pain when the product accidentally gets into her eyes, lasting hours, despite otherwise valuing the glow effect.

aspects.libelle: Stings if it gets in eyes

extraits.texte: You can definetely notice a glowing effect after a few days if use, but if you accidentally get it in your eyes its stings for HOURS. I love the effect it gives, but I find myself not using it just out if fear of hurting my eyes, and it REALLY hurts.

I bought this very expensive serum expecting amazing results. I seem to be odd man out because i didn't notice anything. It is extremely fragrant and thats about it. Well not every product is great for everyone. I am 64 maybe it works better for younger skin.

If you are on tbe fence about buying this due to the price, please read. This serum is worth every penny. It will transform your skin into glowing radiance especially if you drink a lot of water. Not only does it smell heavenly, but it feels like actual silk in a creamy balm form. If I were a billionaire I would slather my entire body with this every single day. Yes, it is expensive — but the 1.7 oz bottle lasted me almost 3 months even with 2x daily application. Within just a few weeks' of consistent use of the serum, I noticed that I was getting SO many compliments on how good and healthy my skin looked. Even in my 30's I found myself struggling with cystic acne, texture unevenness, and skin discoloration. I felt very self-conscious about the way my skin looked without a full face of makeup. This serum cleared up my skin completely to the point where I don't feel the need to wear foundation every day and STILL get compliments on my skin! Buy it, buy it, BUY IT!!!!!!!

extraits.titre: My go-to for a flawless finish!
extraits.texte: This is my second bottle of Dior Dreamskin Care & Perfect and I'll continue repurchasing in the future. Note: it is worth mentioning that this product is quite heavily fragranced. I personally love the fragrance as I find it very spa-like & relaxing. If you don't like/are sensitive to fragrance you may want to pass on this. This lightweight product is usually the last step in my skincare regimen as it leaves my skin ready for makeup. It seems to magically blur my pores and bring my skin to life. However, now that the summer heat & humidity have officially arrived I have little desire to suffocate my skin with makeup. During these hot summer months I often mix this Dreamskin Care & Perfect with some bronzing drops (currently using Pacifica Sunny Glow Bronzing Drops but have also used others like Drunk Elephant D-Bronzi, etc) to even out my skin & give it a natural looking, bronzed glow. This little combo gives me the absolute BEST no makeup makeup look & my skin can breathe! Sometimes, if I want a more matte look, I'll use a powder foundation over top. Regardless of how you choose to proceed with your makeup, this product will give you that beautiful, blurred, flawless airbrushed skin look. Highly recommend this Dior skin perfector!
amazing. 11/10. helped my cystic acne and calms skin, hydrates, AND blurs. LOVE this stuff

I'm 45 and I've been using this for about 10 years. I've tried nearly every other high end brand, this is the one that makes my skin soft and silky so I never go without it. The price is high and also it's worth it to me.
It might work well but the small is so over bearing I had to wipe it off.

reserve: With only 13 reviews and few explicit skin-type mentions beyond age and sensitivity to fragrance, conclusions for skin types like oily, dry, combination, and normal cannot be drawn from this set.
